Normal.

Signal de la moelle osseuse :
Normal.

 Others

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Intermittent pain for 4 months.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness fissuring along the inferior medial trochlea with subchondral cystic change. Focal fissuring at the central trochlea. Low-grade partial thickness chondrosis at the median ridge of patella. 

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. There is lateral patellar translation. No lateral patellar tilt. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.

A. Ligaments  
  ACL: High grade partial tear. 
  PCL: low grade partial tear at the femoral side with tendinosis and focal buckling 
  MCL:  
   deep; partial tear 
   superficial; grade II along the whole ligament (especially the posterior part)  
  LCL complex: intact.  
  The popliteus tendon: high grade intraarticular partial tear 
  The biceps femoris tendon; intact 
  The iliotibial band; grade I injury at the inferior portion 
  
 B. Menisci  
  Medial meniscus: contusion at posterior part of body, suspect focal tear at posterior root, ddx with striated anatomy 
  Lateral meniscus: intact.  
  
 C. Extensor Mechanism  
  Distal quadriceps tendon: Thickening and suspected intrasubstrance partial tear of the posterior bundle  
  Patellar tendon: Normal.  
  Patella: Normally located in the femoral groove.  
  
 D. Fluid  and  Soft Tissue  
  No soft tissue mass.  
  A 1.9x1.0 cm Baker's cyst is seen.  
  No other spaceoccupying lesion is visualized.  
  Physiologic left knee joint effusion is shown. 
  
 E. Osseous Structures  and  Articular Cartilages  
  Bone contusions at the posterior intercondyla 
  Bone marrow edema with cortical stepping at posterolateral tibial plateu; suspect fracture 
  Articular cartilage are intact.  ACL: High grade partial tear. 
  PCL: low grade partial tear at the femoral side with tendinosis and focal buckling 
  MCL:  
   deep; partial tear 
   superficial; grade II along the whole ligament (especially the posterior part)  
  The popliteus tendon: high grade intraarticular partial tear 
  The iliotibial band; grade I injury at the inferior portion 
  Medial meniscus: contusion at posterior part of body, suspect focal tear at posterior root, ddx with striated anatomy 
  Distal quadriceps tendon: Thickening and suspected intrasubstrance partial tear of the posterior bundle  
  A 1.9x1.0 cm Baker's cyst 
  Bone contusions at the posterior intercondyla

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Obs. Hoffitis.
Hallazgos:
Leve adelgazamiento difuso del LCA, probablemente secuelar. LCP y ligamento colateral lateral sin
alteraciones.
Leve engrosamiento secuelar del tercio proximal del componente superficial del ligamento colateral medial.
El resto de los componentes sin alteraciones.
Menisco lateral de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura. Discreto aumento de señal de la
unión meniscocapsular del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial, que podría representar una lesión
parcial regional, correlacionar con clínica.
Cartílagos los compartimentos femorotibiales y patelofemoral sin alteraciones significativas.
No hay derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos patológicos. Discreto edema de las partes blandas entre
cóndilo femoral medial y los tendones de la pata de ganso.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura. Discreto edema el
paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital, supra rotuliano .
Tendón rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Discreto edema de las partes blandas entre la banda de tibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
Impresión:
Discreto adelgazamiento que impresiona secuelar del LCA.
Leve engrosamiento secuelar del ligamento colateral medial.
Probable lesión parcial de la unión meniscocapsular a nivel del cuerno posterior del menisco medial.
Probables fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial y postero mediales de la rodilla.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal. Edema del paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano, hallazgo
inespecífico, podría representar fenómenos de mal alineamiento rotuliano

 The lateral compartment, the lateral meniscus is not torn. The articular cartilage appears normal.  
  
 The patellofemoral joint, high grade chondrosis at mid PF joint both sides. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is low grade partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. The posterior cruciate ligament is partial tear with stretching. There is anterior tibial translation.  
  
 The medial collateral ligamentous complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
  
 Some amount of left effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal.  The posterior cruciate ligament is partial tear with stretching 
  High grade chondrosis at mid PF joint both sides

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Diz eklemini oluşturan her 3 kompartmanda santral-marjinal osteofit formasyonu izlendi. Medial menisküs diz ekleminden 6 mm mediale ekstrudedir. Menisküste hacim kaybı, gövde kesiminde  bütünlük kaybı, posterior hornunda grade III dejenerasyon izlendi. Lateral menisküs anterior-posterior horn ve gövde kesimde grade II dejenerasyon ve serbest kenara uzanan horizontal yırtık izlendi. Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikiği izlendi. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Patella medial fasette kartilaj bütünlüğünde yer yer fokal kayıp izlendi. Suprapatellar bursada sıvı artışı izlendi. Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu kemik yüzlerde subkondrial skleroz, subkondrial dejeneratif kistler ve subkondrial ödem izlendi. Bu düzeyde femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda destrüksiyon izlenmektedir. Bulgular dejeneratif artrit lehine yorumlandı. Sonuç: Gonartroz. Medial menisküste mediale ekstrüzyon, volüm kaybı, gövde kesimde bütünlük kaybı,  posterior hornda grade III meniskopati, lateral menisküste grade II meniskopati ve eşlik eden horizontal yırtık. Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon.Patella medial fasette grade III kondromalazi.  Suprapatellar bursit.

In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, likewise, appears normal including meniscus and articular cartilage.  
 The patellofemoral joint appears congruent. There is no cartilage injury. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 The anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 The medial and lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. 
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 No knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion. Normal MR examination of the left knee.  Specifically there is no evidence of meniscal, ligamentous, or articular cartilage abnormality.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Tendinitis suprapatelar.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones difusas de señal de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales de grosor y señal normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservadas, sin signos de rotura.
Alteración de señal intrasustancia del cartílago del platillo tibial lateral. Adelgazamiento condral de
espesor parcial en la región posterocentral de carga del cóndilo femoral medial. Aumento de señal
intrasustancia e irregularidad superficial del cartílago de la región central y faceta lateral de la
patela. Resto del cartílago de compartimentos femorotibiales y patelofemoral de grosor y señal
normales.
Leve derrame articular. No se observan quistes poplíteos.
Tendón del cuádriceps, patelar, poplíteo, semimembranoso, bíceps femoral, banda iliotibial y
tendones de la pata de ganso de grosor y señal normales.
Discreto edema del aspecto superolateral de la grasa de Hoffa. Discreto edema del paquete
adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano.
Grupos musculares de trofismo y señal normales.
Impresión:
Condropatía del platillo tibial lateral y cóndilo femoral medial grado 1 y 2. Condropatía patelar
grado 1-2.
Signos de hiperpresión patelar externa. Discreto edema del paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital
suprarrotuliano, hallazgo inespecífico, podría representar fenómenos de mal alineamiento
rotuliano.
Leve derrame articular.

Findings:  No significant knee effusion. There is a small free edge radial tear of the posterolateral corner of the lateral meniscus. Normal medial meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, LCL. There is mild thickening of the proximal half of MCL in keeping with a low grade, grade  II MCL sprain.  Mild normal tibiofemoral articular cartilage. Fraying and fissuring of the medial patellar facet articular cartilage is noted. Normal trochlear articular cartilage.  
Conclusion: Free edge radial tear of the posterolateral corner of the lateral meniscus. 
Healing low grade, grade  II MCL sprain. Grade 2 patellar chondromalacia.
